items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think Pickett had the same trouble. Pickett had the same trouble too. That's right. Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, Pinkett too had the same trouble over there. That's how Pinkett had quit the job.

ctx.x: thing I don't play from up here. Comes right up. Blow from down your stomach. Down my stomach. You see I don't, you see plenty of fellas when they play a horn their neck swell like that. But I don't do that. Play my horn like that. Play from right from up like that. See when you're walking, you're bringing pressure up to you all the time like that. It's coming up to you all the time. In case you fellas blowin, all this button out all the neck. You know those like. Louis Armstrong does. Yeah. Louis Armstrong and…
I think Pickett had the same trouble. Pickett had the same trouble too. That's right. Yeah.

Well, Pinkett too had the same trouble over there. That's how Pinkett had quit the job. And the Pinkett quit. After Pinkett quit, Cad went back there and Cad got the same trouble. Now Alvin told me that's when Alvin no one wake over there. Man do you know. Now Thomas. Of course this time, Thomas had to go down this time blow it up on Thomas. Thomas did have that you let blow down on him one time. Uh huh. You hitin' them high notes like that. You can't be hitin' them high notes like that. Yeah. It's gonna spoil…
